title: RX Radio - Uganda's Number One Online Radio Station

lines.l: I come scoop you in that coop, sitting on two zeros, fix your hair, we're in the mirror, let's roll
You know you like that, you know you like that
I can't stop listening to Rx Radio, the music is too good
I got my swing, roll it, roll out, drop that, roll out, roll out, roll out, roll out
So drop that, roll it on 20
Drop it, drop it, your melody

It's Cruise Control, where the music, the energy, and the fun never stops.
